name: claude-cardputer-bridge
description: Local bridge between Claude and an M5Stack Cardputer ADV console.
long_description: Runs a local MCP server plus localhost WebSocket bridge for optional Cardputer ADV features that are outside the official Claude Hardware Buddy BLE protocol.

tools.name: notify_cardputer
tools.description: Send a concise status or summary to the connected Cardputer.

tools.name: ask_cardputer
tools.description: Ask the Cardputer user a short question and wait for an answer.

tools.name: get_cardputer_prompt
tools.description: Read the next prompt draft queued from the Cardputer.

tools.name: device_status
tools.description: Report bridge and Cardputer connection status.

bridge_port.title: Bridge Port
bridge_port.description: Localhost HTTP/WebSocket port for the Cardputer bridge.

pairing_token.title: Pairing Token
pairing_token.description: Optional shared token. Leave blank to let the bridge generate and persist one locally.

bind_host.title: Bind Host
bind_host.description: Network interface for the local bridge. Use 127.0.0.1 for Desktop-only use, or 0.0.0.0 for physical Cardputer Wi-Fi testing on your LAN.

verbose_logging.title: Verbose Logging
verbose_logging.description: Print extra bridge diagnostics to stderr.
